title: Add Two Numbers
code:
Use io, alloc, core, and list.

A record ListNode has a value as a whole number and a next as a pointer to ListNode.

Define function make_node taking value as a whole number returning a pointer to ListNode:
    Let size be 16 as an unsigned number.
    Let raw be allocate size bytes.
    Let node be raw as a pointer to ListNode.
    Set node's value to value.
    Set node's next to no address as a pointer to ListNode.
    Give back node.
Done.

Define function build_list taking digits as a pointer to List of whole number, n as an unsigned number returning a pointer to ListNode:
    Let head be no address as a pointer to ListNode.
    Let tail be head.
    For every i from 0 as an unsigned number to n - 1:
        Let node be make_node(list_get(digits, i)).
        If head as an unsigned number is 0:
            Set head to node.
            Set tail to node.
        Otherwise:
            Set tail's next to node.
            Set tail to node.
    Give back head.
Done.

Define function add_lists taking first as a pointer to ListNode, second as a pointer to ListNode returning a pointer to ListNode:
    Let head be no address as a pointer to ListNode.
    Let tail be head.
    Let carry start at 0.
    Let a be first.
    Let b be second.
    Repeat while a as an unsigned number isn't 0 or b as an unsigned number isn't 0 or carry is more than 0:
        Let total be carry.
        If a as an unsigned number isn't 0:
            Add a's value to total.
            Set a to a's next.
        If b as an unsigned number isn't 0:
            Add b's value to total.
            Set b to b's next.
        Let node be make_node(total modulo 10).
        Set carry to total divided by 10.
        If head as an unsigned number is 0:
            Set head to node.
            Set tail to node.
        Otherwise:
            Set tail's next to node.
            Set tail to node.
    Give back head.
Done.

Define function print_list taking head as a pointer to ListNode:
    Let cursor be head.
    Repeat while cursor as an unsigned number isn't 0:
        Say cursor's value.
        Set cursor to cursor's next.
Done.

Define function release_list taking head as a pointer to ListNode:
    Let cursor be head.
    Repeat while cursor as an unsigned number isn't 0:
        Let following be cursor's next.
        release memory at cursor as a pointer to byte.
        Set cursor to following.
Done.

Let first digits be a list of 2, 4, and 3.
Let second digits be a list of 5, 6, and 4.
Let first count be count of first digits.
Let second count be count of second digits.
Let first list be build_list(address of first digits, first count).
Let second list be build_list(address of second digits, second count).
Let answer be add_lists(first list, second list).
print_list(answer).
release_list(answer).
release_list(second list).
release_list(first list).
list_free(address of second digits).
list_free(address of first digits).
Return 0.

        Set value to 0 - value.
    If value is more than 2147483647:
        Give back 2147483647.
    If value is less than -2147483648:

    Give back value.

title: Regular Expression Matching
code:
Use io, list, and string.

Define function regex_matches taking text as a pointer to TcString, pattern as a pointer to TcString returning a truth value:
    Let n be length of text.
    Let m be length of pattern.
    Let width be m + 1.
    Let table be an empty list of bytes.
    For every index from 0 as an unsigned number to (n + 1) * width - 1:
        push 0 to address of table.
    list_set(address of table, 0, 1).
    For every j from 1 as an unsigned number to m:
        If pattern.data[j - 1] equals 42 and j is at least 2:
            Let prior be list_get(address of table, j - 2).
            If prior is 1:
                list_set(address of table, j, 1).
    For every i from 1 as an unsigned number to n:
        For every j from 1 as an unsigned number to m:
            Let slot be i * width + j.
            Let character be pattern.data[j - 1].
            If character equals 46 or character equals text.data[i - 1]:
                Let diagonal slot be (i - 1) * width + j - 1.
                Let diagonal be list_get(address of table, diagonal slot).
                If diagonal is 1:
                    list_set(address of table, slot, 1).
            Otherwise:
                If character equals 42 and j is at least 2:
                    Let zero slot be i * width + j - 2.
                    Let zero match be list_get(address of table, zero slot).
                    Let prior character be pattern.data[j - 2].
                    Let repeat match be false.
                    If prior character equals 46 or prior character equals text.data[i - 1]:
                        Let above slot be (i - 1) * width + j.
                        If list_get(address of table, above slot) is 1:
                            Set repeat match to true.
                    If zero match is 1 or repeat match is true:
                        list_set(address of table, slot, 1).
    Let answer slot be n * width + m.
    Let answer be list_get(address of table, answer slot).
    list_free(address of table).
    Give back answer is 1.
Done.

Let first pattern be str_from_bytes(bytes_ptr("a"), bytes_len("a")).
